title: Resume LA2K1000 persistent ext4 Git validation after fchown StepOp fix
current_state: The PR worktree is /home/msp/learning/Txv2 on feature/portable-net-vf2-dwmac at base 460152ced with unstaged fixes; /home/msp/learning/Txv2-main-baseline was not edited.

LA sda1 ext4 RW completed an add-only HTTPS shallow clone under /root/txv2-460152ced-20260815-m; after physical reset, the same artifact mounted sda1 RO and the repository HEAD plus full fsck were intact.
LA five-stream TCP passed in both directions and five-stream UDP received 8560/8560 datagrams with zero loss while the root remained read-only.

BusyBox periodic ping exposed both a caught-signal frame VM-Yield bug and a physical-only LoongArch old-world ABI mismatch. Signal-frame materialization now waits asynchronously, and LA signal syscalls accept 8-byte new-world or 16-byte old-world sigsets while RV remains 8-byte-only.

The final physical artifact /srv/tftp/txv2/txv2-la2k1000-pr-460152ced-oldworldsig-3fd30c0d.uimage (SHA-256 3fd30c0d96dffc9ffcc65b4ec2aa332de467185342c6ee433e5c5f912c535914) booted sda1 read-only; Python SIG_IGN/mask/pending, Bash caught-handler return, and BusyBox periodic ping 3/3 plus 600/600 all passed.

changed_files.reason: Remove invalid chmod/chown one-shot classification and retain target across Yield.
Drive fchmodat/fchownat through the full Waiting driver.
Cover chmod/chown metadata-admission Yield and target retention.
Use Linux informational descriptor UUID semantics for production recovery while preserving strict diagnostics and RO preflight.
Expose opt-in RO journal preflight before root mount.
Wait asynchronously for caught-signal stack materialization and replay the immutable frame after VM Yield.
Support LoongArch 8-byte new-world and 16-byte old-world rt-signal wire ABIs without widening the internal 64-signal model.
Document the native 8-byte constants and the separate LoongArch old-world compatibility wire.

next_actions.title: Classify or repair the remaining main unit regressions before PR submission

caveats: Never issue dd, mkfs, partitioning, repair fsck, raw block writes, U-Boot saveenv, flash writes, or media write commands.
QEMU verify-git clones under /home tmpfs and is a network/Git functional witness, not a persistent ext4 witness.

Two interactive attempts missed the zero-second U-Boot window and let factory Linux mount sda1 RW; no agent command ran there, but systemd wrote its own journals. Future boots must use the 5 ms atomic UART interceptor.
Global step/ad-hoc-drive ratchets plus tx-shims and two tx-kernel unit groups have pre-existing failures outside the focused fixes.
